notes.title: The Nuke Demo Has Dropped!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750115/a846be951d63dafa59357d76d82d2640c9688ba3.png[/img]

The Nuke Zone demo has officially been released, and we are over the cybergalactic moon!! Chat with the Devs on Steam Broadcast, and [b]leave any feedback you have in the Nuke Zone community hub.[/b]
Don't forget to wishlist to keep watch! 👀☄️

[list]
[*] Choose from an assortment of ridiculous laser-weapons and unleash your retro fury upon all who stand in your way!
[*] Tune your tank to perfection and create the ultimate loadout to overcome any challenge placed before you!
[*] Select from a variety of electrifying mission types! Can you survive wave upon wave of unrelenting enemies in the Survival Mode? Will you smash through obstacles and crush high scores in the adrenaline-fueled cyber-tank races?
[/list]
[previewyoutube=_HMGdQl58S0;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1255530/Nuke_Zone/

notes.title: Introducing KillStreak.tv!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32204839/d74f2c0e6d839734f60cfe7b80fa4aab85881216.jpg[/img]

Hey Blue Wizard fans! We are proud to announce that the online multiplayer bullet-battling gameshow, KillStreak.tv is making its official Steam debut! Hop on over to the Steam store and download KillStreak.tv for FREE today!

KillStreak.tv is a fast-paced 'Free for All' online multiplayer third-person shooter. Jump in different arenas, defeat your opponents using a range of customizable weapons, and look good doing it with character customization and tons of unlockable gear.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32204839/3a6e9256929fc15f11393a53c46f21216353cf28.jpg[/img]

[h1]Key Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fast-paced shooting action: Run 'n gun, improve your score and rewards with kill streaks
[*] Three arena levels to play in: Warehouse Warfare, Bar Room Brawl & Carpark Carnage
[*] Earn Kill Coins to unlock new Items: Including weapons, hats, heads and costumes
[*] Earn XP for equipped gear: Level items up to unlock new Skins and Mods
[*] Tons of Skins and Mods available for each Item, with more content coming soon...
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1053060/KillStreaktv/

notes.title: F13KP Patch Notes - v1.6.4
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32204839/141c0c7d2e4698c39a3425aec81d069146494994.gif[/img]

Hey Slayers! We've had an incredible launch week and already have over [b]2 MILLION PLAYERS[/b] slashing their way through Camp Crystal Lake and beyond! We've updated the game on Steam with a new version that includes a handful of bug fixes and optimizations. Feel free to get in touch (support@bluewizard.com) if you notice anything strange while you're running the game and we can be sure it gets dealt with as quickly as possible in a future update!

Here's a quick rundown on what you can find in the 1.6.4 Patch:
[list]
[*] Found those missing DLC Jason weapons -- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/795100/discussions/1/1696045708641004861/]check here for info on restoring them[/url]
[*] Resolved a save game issue
[*] Tidied up some visual content & bugs
[*] Fixed the Lucky Number 13 achievement
[*] Squashed some bugs involving puzzle solutions
[*] Fixed a bug where rewinding caused music to stop playing
[*] Fixed several minor ui bugs
[*] Fixed bug with Steam Controller Support -- should now be functional!
[/list]

Thanks so much for making this an incredible launch for us! Your positive feedback and excitement has been keeping us going strong. Thank you so much for the kind and thoughtful reviews — keep em coming!!

Cheers,
The Blue Wizards :slayawayknife:
